column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for the Phase 5 dynamic test.
# The baseline scan runs as the breadth check and reports to the run. The passive
# browser-hardening alerts below are set to WARN (reported, not failing) with a
# reason: the target is a machine-to-machine test API with no browser surface, so
# response security headers are not the control under test. The binding control for
# this release is the authorisation gate, proven by the access-control probe and
# enforced by the policy gate, not by these passive alerts.

column3: Incomplete or no cache-control header: accepted, API responses are not browser-cached.
Content-Type missing on some responses: accepted for the test harness.
Anti-clickjacking header (X-Frame-Options) absent: accepted, no browser surface.
X-Content-Type-Options header absent: accepted, no browser surface.
Server header leaks the uvicorn version: accepted for the lab.
X-Powered-By header present: accepted for the lab.
Content-Security-Policy header absent: accepted, no browser surface.
Non-storable or non-cacheable content: accepted, dynamic API responses.
Permissions-Policy header absent: accepted, no browser surface.
Timestamp disclosure: accepted, not sensitive in this test harness.
Insufficient site isolation headers: accepted, no browser surface.
